app.title: Edibert
warning.rule_shadowed: Rule "{rule}" never applies because rule "{by}" matches first.
error.HOLIDAY_REGION_MISSING: Holiday logic needs a region (federal state or canton) in the house profile.
error.PRICE_MISSING: No price for slot {slot} in tariff "{tariff_id}".
error.ID_COLLISION: Tariff ID "{tariff_id}" is used more than once.
error.FILE_INVALID: The file "{path}" cannot be read or is not valid JSON.
error.ID_PREFIX_MISSING: User tariff IDs must start with "user_" ("{tariff_id}").
error.ID_PREFIX_RESERVED: Catalog tariff "{tariff_id}" uses the reserved prefix "user_".
error.MARKET_PRICE_REQUIRED: Tariff "{tariff_id}" needs a market price for slot {slot}.
error.CAPACITY_CHARGE_MISSING: No capacity charge of grid area "{area_id}" covers {month}. Add an entry for this month or include its status.
error.CAPACITY_STATE_MISSING: The month-to-date peak for {month} is missing.
error.CAPACITY_STATE_MONTH_MISMATCH: The month-to-date peak belongs to {state_month}, not to {month}.
error.MARKET_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: No market prices are available for zone {zone}. Check the internet connection and the price sources.
error.MARKET_ZONE_UNKNOWN: There is no market zone for country "{land}". Supported countries: AT, DE, CH.
error.FORECAST_KEY_MISSING: The forecast plug-in needs a key. Set it in the environment variable {env}, or choose the forecast method "mirror" or "hold".
error.MQTT_LIBRARY_MISSING: MQTT support is not installed. Install it with: pip install "edibert[mqtt]"
error.MQTT_CONNECTION_FAILED: Cannot connect to the MQTT broker {host}:{port}.
error.CONTRIBUTION_INDIVIDUAL: Tariff "{tariff_id}" is personal and is never shared.
error.CONTRIBUTION_LAND_MISSING: Tariff "{tariff_id}" has no country. Set the country to share it.
error.CONTRIBUTION_TRANSPORT_OFF: Sharing is off: the exchange with the tariff database is not set up or switched off.
error.EXCHANGE_OFF: The exchange with the tariff database is switched off ({env}=1).
error.EXCHANGE_UNREACHABLE: The tariff database server cannot be reached right now ({route}). Prices are not affected; try again later.
error.EXCHANGE_RATE_LIMITED: The tariff database asks to wait before the next request ({retry_after} s).
error.EXCHANGE_REJECTED: The tariff database rejected the request ({route}: {server_code}).
error.EXCHANGE_ANSWER_INVALID: The tariff database sent an answer Edibert does not understand ({route}). Nothing was changed.
error.RULE_VALUE_MISSING: Rule "{rule_id}" has no value yet; remove its status from the included statuses or add the value.
warning.WINDOW_NOT_HOUR_ALIGNED: Rule "{rule_id}" of tariff "{tariff_id}" does not start and end on a full hour, but the tariff is settled hourly.
warning.GRID_RULE_SKIPPED_STATUS: Grid rule "{rule_id}" is not applied (status "{status}" is not included).
warning.GRID_RULE_SKIPPED_NO_QUARTER_HOU: Grid rule "{rule_id}" is not applied (no quarter-hour meter).
cli.capacity_title: Capacity charge {charge_id}, {month}: no extra cost up to {free} kW
cli.capacity_amount: Month amount at a peak of {power} kW: {eur} EUR (net)
cli.capacity_none: Grid area {area_id} has no capacity charge in {month}.
warning.RULE_SHADOWED: Rule "{rule_id}" never takes effect: rule "{by}" matches first. Move it up or change the time window.
warning.RULE_NEVER_APPLIES: Rule "{rule_id}" never applies (check months, days and validity).
warning.PRICE_UNUSUAL: The price {value} ct/kWh is unusual. Please check the unit (cent, not euro) and whether it is net or gross.
warning.SPOT_PRICES_GROSS: Spot tariffs normally use net prices plus VAT; "{tariff_id}" is set to gross prices. Please check.
warning.MARKET_DATA_INCOMPLETE: Market prices for {zone} end before {missing_from}. Later prices are not published.
warning.MARKET_CACHE_UNREADABLE: The price cache "{path}" is damaged and is rebuilt.
warning.FORECAST_FAILED: Forecaster "{name}" failed ({reason}). Only exact prices are published.
warning.MONTH_RATE_FALLBACK: Tariff "{tariff_id}" has no monthly rate for {month}; the rate of {used_month} is used ({rule}). Please add the month to the tariff.
warning.MARKET_RANGE_INCOMPLETE: Market prices for {zone} are missing from {missing_from} on ({missing_slots} quarter hours).
warning.GRID_CAPACITY_SKIPPED_STATUS: Capacity charge "{charge_id}" is not applied (status "{status}" is not included).
warning.CAPACITY_BANDS_NOT_CONVEX: Capacity charge "{charge_id}": a band has a lower rate than the band below it. Optimizers cannot model this with linear segments; please check the rates.
warning.CAPACITY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: Grid area "{area_id}" bills a capacity charge, but the house has no quarter-hour meter, so the month-to-date peak cannot be supplied.
warning.CONTRIBUTION_TRANSPORT_OFF: Sharing is off: the exchange with the tariff database is not set up or switched off. You can check what would be sent; nothing leaves this computer.
ui.title: Edibert tariff editor
ui.start_hint: Create a new tariff above or open an existing one.
ui.host_house_hint: These values come from the house profile and are changed there.
ui.region_help: Needed when a tariff has weekday rules, because public holidays can change prices.
ui.grid_hint: Applies to every tariff, whatever the supplier.
ui.grid_enabled: Include the grid fee in prices
ui.grid_rules: Time windows of the grid fee (for example high and low tariff)
ui.migrate_hint: Your tariff files are from an older format. Migrate them to continue. Copy the data folder first if you want a backup.
ui.no_catalog: No catalog configured. Start with --catalog FILE.
ui.copy_none: No catalog tariff matches these filters.
ui.copy_no_region: Without the federal state / canton of the house, regional tariffs of other regions are shown too.
ui.import_direction: Direction (if the file does not say)
ui.import_renamed: "{old}" was renamed to "{new}" (own tariffs start with user_).
ui.import_collides: "{tariff_id}" already exists. Tick the box above to replace it.
ui.share_intro_share: Your saved tariffs are shared unless you leave them out. Below is exactly what is sent. Personal tariffs, notes and the names of your time windows are never sent.
ui.share_intro_opt_in: Nothing is shared until you select a tariff. Below is exactly what is sent. Personal tariffs, notes and the names of your time windows are never sent.
ui.share_done: Sent: {accepted} accepted, {duplicate} already in the catalog, {rejected} rejected.
ui.share_reject.CONTRIBUTION_FORMAT_UNSU: The server does not support this version of Edibert's share format; update Edibert.
ui.share_reject.TARIFF_INVALID: The server found the tariff incomplete or invalid (for example a missing country).
ui.share_reject.CONTRIBUTION_INDIVIDUAL: The tariff is marked as personal.
ui.share_reject.VERSION_MISMATCH: The server computes a different price version for this tariff; Edibert and the server may be on different versions.
ui.share_reject.MODERATION_REJECTED: This exact tariff was removed from the catalog by moderation.
ui.label: Name of the tariff
ui.tariff_land_help: Prefilled with the country of the house. Tariff lists are filtered by country.
ui.tariff_regions_help: Fill in only if the tariff is offered in part of the country. Empty = the whole country.
ui.markup_percent: Percentage markup on the market price (%)
ui.feed_in_fee_factor: Fee as share of the market price (0.19 = 19 %)
ui.mtu.60min: hourly (mean of the four quarter hours)
ui.monthly_hint: One price per month. A missing month stops the calculation instead of guessing.
ui.vat_hint_spot: Market-price tariffs usually state net prices plus VAT.
ui.spot_rules_hint: For market tariffs the rows are surcharges or discounts in ct/kWh (value 0 to fill in).
ui.first_wins_hint: The first matching row wins, so the order matters.
ui.fees_hint: Fixed monthly costs, entered like the prices above (net or gross). Leave 0 if there are none.
ui.holidays.own: only for rows that name holidays
ui.extra_holidays: Extra days that count as holidays
ui.extra_holidays_help: One date per line, YYYY-MM-DD (for example 24 and 31 December).
ui.individual_help: Personal tariffs are never shared with the catalog.
ui.preview_spot_note: Market tariff: shown with an example market curve, not a forecast.
ui.invoice_hint: Enter the kWh from a real invoice for one month. Edibert recalculates the total and shows the difference.
ui.invoice_market: Average market price of the month (ct/kWh)
ui.invoice_off: The numbers differ by more than {tolerance} %. Check net/gross, the time windows, the fees and the grid fee.
cli.ui_missing: Streamlit is not installed. Install it with: pip install "edibert[ui]"
cli.publish_start: Publishing {count} tariff(s) to the MQTT broker {host}:{port}. Stop with Ctrl+C.
cli.publish_dry_run: Dry run: nothing is sent to a broker.
warning.RULE_PRICE_UNUSUAL: The price {value} ct/kWh of time window "{rule_id}" is unusual. Please check the unit (cent, not euro) and whether it is net or gross.
field.label: name
error.VAT_PERCENT_MISSING: Tariff "{tariff_id}" has no VAT rate. Enter the VAT rate (0 is allowed).
error.GRID_ID_COLLISION: Grid ID "{grid_id}" is used more than once.
error.GRID_ID_PREFIX_MISSING: Own grid areas and rule sets must start with "user_" ("{grid_id}").
error.GRID_ID_PREFIX_RESERVED: Catalog grid ID "{grid_id}" uses the reserved prefix "user_".
error.FORMAT_MISSING: The file "{path}" has no tariff-format version. Migrate it first.
error.FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: The file "{path}" has tariff-format version {value}; this version of Edibert reads {supported}.
error.MIGRATION_ANSWER_MISSING: The migration question "{question_id}" has no answer.
question.VAT_PERCENT: VAT rate in percent for tariff "{label}" ({tariff_id}, {direction}, {prices} prices, country {land})
error.TARIFF_NOT_VALID: Tariff "{tariff_id}" has no price version valid on {date}.
error.DB_ID_UNAVAILABLE: "{tariff_id}" is an own entry and has no tariff-database ID; the database assigns one when it is shared.
error.TARIFF_VALIDITY_OVERLAP: The price versions of tariff "{tariff_id}" overlap in time.
error.PACKAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: This is not a catalog package this Edibert version can read (format {value}).
error.PACKAGE_KEY_UNKNOWN: The catalog package is signed with an unknown key ("{key_id}"). It is not imported.
error.PACKAGE_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The signature of the catalog package is not valid (key "{key_id}"). The package was changed or damaged and is not imported.
error.PACKAGE_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The file "{file}" in the catalog package was changed after signing. The package is not imported.
error.PACKAGE_IMPORT_CONFLICT: The monthly rate "{conflict}" was entered locally and would be lost. Decide whether to keep it or take the package's value.
warning.PACKAGE_EXPIRED: The catalog package was valid until {valid_until}. It stays usable, but gets no more updates.
warning.EXCHANGE_JOB_FAILED: Catalog exchange: the job "{job}" failed ({code}). Prices are not affected; it is tried again in an hour.
warning.PACKAGE_HELD_CONFLICTS: The catalog package {package_id} was not imported: {count} monthly rate(s) entered locally would change. Import it in the editor and decide per rate.
warning.PACKAGE_HELD_REMOVES_USED: The catalog package {package_id} was not imported: it no longer contains tariffs that are published ({entries}). Choose other tariffs in publish.json or import it in the editor.
ui.db_ref_differs: Copied from the {database} tariff database: {id}. The prices now differ from version {version}.
ui.package_hint: A signed package replaces the catalog files. Your own tariffs stay unchanged.
ui.package_unreadable: The file is not valid JSON.
ui.package_ok: Signature valid: package {package_id} of the {database} tariff database, valid until {valid_until}.
ui.package_conflicts: {count} monthly rates were entered locally and differ from the package. Decide for each one.
ui.package_fetch: Load newest package of the {database} tariff database
ui.package_unchanged: The catalog already holds the newest package ({package_id}).
ui.package_server_off: Loading from the tariff database server is switched off (EDIBERT_EXCHANGE_OFF=1). You can still import a package file.
ui.db_status: Tariff database ({checked}): {reliable}, used by {count} installations in the last 12 months.
ui.db_status_unknown: Tariff database ({checked}): this version is not known (yet).
ui.db_status_newer: A newer version is valid from {valid_from}. Import the newest catalog package and copy the tariff again.
ui.db_status_off: The status in the tariff database cannot be asked: the exchange is switched off (EDIBERT_EXCHANGE_OFF=1).
cli.package_ok: Package {package_id} ({database}) is valid: issued {issued_at}, valid until {valid_until}.
cli.exchange_unchanged: The {database} database has no newer package.
cli.exchange_fetched: Package of the {database} database saved to {path}. Check and import it with 'package import'.
cli.exchange_nothing: None of the tariffs in use stands for a database version; nothing to ask or report.
cli.exchange_status: {db_id}: up to date, reliable: {reliable}, installations (12 months): {count}
cli.exchange_status_outdated: {db_id}: newer version from {valid_from}, reliable: {reliable}, installations (12 months): {count}
